U1.label: UNSUPPORTED
U1.reason: Attributes the overturned acquiescence finding to the High Court rather than the lower appellate court.

U2.label: SUPPORTED
U2.reason: The landlord invoked the specified pre-commencement exception.

U3.label: UNSUPPORTED
U3.reason: Landlord reliance on a statutory ground was a pleaded position, not an undisputed case fact.

U4.label: UNSUPPORTED
U4.reason: A landlord allegation alone does not establish the statutory ground; timing and consent have separate evidentiary bases.

U5.label: SUPPORTED
U5.reason: The majority agreed occupation knowledge did not prove knowledge of subtenancy or acquiescence.

U6.label: SUPPORTED
U6.reason: The stated adopted-evaluation status matches the majority’s express agreement.

U7.label: UNSUPPORTED
U7.reason: Prior Association role is material context, but C056/C064/C078 do not declare that historical role; selected claims are insufficient.

U8.label: SUPPORTED
U8.reason: The majority adopted no-evidence review of the acquiescence finding under section 35.

U9.label: SUPPORTED
U9.reason: The evaluative status reflects the majority’s acceptance of the High Court’s result.

U10.label: SUPPORTED
U10.reason: The no-evidence standard under section 35 is stated in the judgment.

U11.label: SUPPORTED
U11.reason: The majority preserved the old Act against materially new statutory rights.

U12.label: SUPPORTED
U12.reason: The legal interpretation is expressly the majority view.

U13.label: SUPPORTED
U13.reason: The harmonising interpretation and protection against new rights are adopted.

U14.label: UNSUPPORTED
U14.reason: Converts “not later than November 1950” to an exact date and miscasts majority reasoning as counterargument.

U15.label: UNSUPPORTED
U15.reason: The majority accepted the 1952 ground; it did not reject the pre-1952 temporal distinction as inapplicable.

U16.label: UNSUPPORTED
U16.reason: An argument expressly left undecided is stated affirmatively and C091/C092 concern revisional evidence, not this hypothesis.

U17.label: SUPPORTED
U17.reason: The hypothetical legal effect of proved acquiescence was expressly left undecided.

U18.label: SUPPORTED
U18.reason: The text expressly declines to determine the legal effect of hypothetical acquiescence.

U19.label: UNSUPPORTED
U19.reason: Dissent is identifiable, but the assertion about future binding precedent extends beyond this judgment and selected declarations.

U20.label: SUPPORTED
U20.reason: C001 identifies the same Pratap Chand in both linked objects.

U21.label: UNSUPPORTED
U21.reason: C001 links one landlord across references; nothing identifies different premises contexts.

U22.label: SUPPORTED
U22.reason: C009 identifies Sobti as the same subtenant across linked objects.

U23.label: UNSUPPORTED
U23.reason: C009 links the same subtenant; the source does not establish different premises contexts.

U24.label: SUPPORTED
U24.reason: This is a source-grounded reconstruction rather than a new factual finding.

ACTORS_IDENTIFIED.label: SUPPORTED
ACTORS_IDENTIFIED.reason: The landlord, Association, subtenant and adjudicating courts are concretely identified.

PROPERTY_IDENTIFIED.label: SUPPORTED
PROPERTY_IDENTIFIED.reason: Room No. 6 in Pratap Buildings is specified and correctly linked.

EVENT_ATTRIBUTION.label: UNSUPPORTED
EVENT_ATTRIBUTION.reason: Conclusion reverses the High Court/lower appellate attribution of the acquiescence finding; grounds relabel a pleaded theory as undisputed.

COURT_STAGES.label: UNSUPPORTED
COURT_STAGES.reason: Although frame lists stages, narrative misattributes the finding set aside and omits reversal of the lower appellate judgment.

ADOPTED_REASONING.label: UNSUPPORTED
ADOPTED_REASONING.reason: Majority statutory construction is present, but it conflates lower appellate and High Court findings and skips operative statutory alternative.

DECISIVE_COUNTERARGUMENTS.label: UNSUPPORTED
DECISIVE_COUNTERARGUMENTS.reason: Mislabels the majority temporal conclusion as rejected; omits the actual dissenting 1958-Act account and nonappeal dispute.

UNCERTAINTY_PRESERVED.label: UNSUPPORTED
UNCERTAINTY_PRESERVED.reason: November 1950 is fixed beyond “not later than”; undecided legal hypothesis is asserted affirmatively and an unselected future-precedent claim is added.

CONCLUSION_SCOPE.label: UNSUPPORTED
CONCLUSION_SCOPE.reason: The entitlement conclusion follows the majority but materially misstates which court made the acquiescence finding.

NO_REJECTED_FACT_REENTRY.label: UNSUPPORTED
NO_REJECTED_FACT_REENTRY.reason: Lower appellate finding of knowledge is appropriately attributed in frame but narrative collapses court findings; unestablished precision re-enters counterargument.

CLAIM_SUPPORT_ALIGNMENT.label: UNSUPPORTED
CLAIM_SUPPORT_ALIGNMENT.reason: C056/C064 do not establish Association-role history, C091/C092 do not concern the acquiescence hypothetical, and selected declarations do not justify several counterargument claims.

NARRATIVE_COMPLETENESS.label: UNSUPPORTED
NARRATIVE_COMPLETENESS.reason: Omits the decisive dissenting statutory account and separate joint-decree appeal issue; no sentence is truncated.
